Image 1: Eleven-panel storyboard reference, used for the overall shot structure, shot sizes, and camera-movement rhythm. Read it from left to right and from top to bottom; panel N is Shot N. It is a line-art sketch: do not adopt its sketch style, black outlines, white background, panel borders or drawn faces.
Image 2: Reference of Garden of the wedding venue, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, a rendered set, not live action. Use it only for the room's layout, the furniture's positions and the light's direction; do not reference its visual content. It contains no people.
Image 3: Reference of Garden of the wedding venue, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, a rendered set, used only for the room's layout; it contains no people.
Image 4: Reference of Garden of the wedding venue, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, a rendered set, used only for the room's layout; it contains no people.
Image 5: Reference of Garden of the wedding venue, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, a rendered set, used only for the room's layout; it contains no people.
Image 6: Reference of Garden of the wedding venue, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, a rendered set, used only for the room's layout; it contains no people.
Image 7: Blocking reference of the segment's start: the same place with these people in their places, used only for where each person is and which way they face; take faces and outfits from each subject's own image. It is a line-art diagram: do not adopt its outlines or white background.
Image 8: Subject 1 (Cassie, look S1) character appearance reference.
Image 9: Subject 2 (Sebastian, look S2) character appearance reference.
Image 10: Subject 3 (Natalie, look S1) character appearance reference.
Image 11: Subject 4 (Officiant) character appearance reference.
Image 12: Subject 5 (Guest 2) character appearance reference.
Image 13: Subject 6 (Guest 1) character appearance reference.
Image 14: Subject 7 (George, look S1) character appearance reference.
Image 15: Subject 8 (Lauren, look S1) character appearance reference.
Image 16: Prop 1 (wedding-gift box) maps to this image; use only structure, material, and color, and copy its writing and badges exactly from Image 16.
Image 17: Prop 2 (glasses of champagne) maps to this image; use only structure, material, and color, and copy its writing and badges exactly from Image 17.
[Subject settings]
Subject 1 (Cassie): Refer to Image 8. 23, Natalie's spoiled stepsister, Lauren's daughter, who pushes Natalie into the marriage meant for her. Outfit: look S1: A scarlet-red satin bodycon cocktail dress with thin straps, a plunging neckline, a cinched waist and a high thigh slit on a short hem. Gold statement hoops, a gold cuff bracelet and gold strappy stilettos. No jacket. Signature colour: red.
Subject 2 (Sebastian): Refer to Image 9. 30, the hero; the scorned illegitimate son of the Klein family, jailed for three days for reckless driving and secretly a billionaire running a plan. Outfit: look S2: A black slim-cut tuxedo jacket with satin lapels, a crisp white dress shirt, a black bow tie, black tuxedo trousers, black patent oxfords, a small white rose boutonnière and the steel-and-black wristwatch. Signature colour: black.
Subject 3 (Natalie): Refer to Image 10. 25, the heroine; George's daughter from his first marriage, who agrees to marry Sebastian Klein to pay for her mother's dialysis. Outfit: look S1: An elegant, figure-fitted ivory-white satin bridal gown with thin spaghetti straps and a low sweetheart neckline. The sculpted bodice is fitted, and the skirt hugs her hips before flaring softly into a floor-length hem. A narrow pale-blue satin sash, her 'something blue', cinches the waist. A short sheer tulle veil is pinned at the back of her curls. Ivory satin pointed-toe heels. No jewellery. Signature colour: blue.
Subject 4 (Officiant): Refer to Image 11. 58, the wedding officiant who marries Natalie and Sebastian. Outfit: A dark charcoal-black two-piece suit over a pale-blue dress shirt with a plain dark tie, a long cream-white satin officiant's stole draped over his shoulders and hanging down the front of the jacket, black leather oxfords and thin gold-framed reading glasses. He holds his hands clasped in front of him. Signature colour: white.
Subject 5 (Guest 2): Refer to Image 12. 25, a gossiping wedding guest. Outfit: A knee-length mustard-yellow sleeveless A-line sundress with a fitted bodice and a round neck, small gold studs, a woven straw clutch and tan sandals. Signature colour: yellow.
Subject 6 (Guest 1): Refer to Image 13. 25, a gossiping wedding guest. Outfit: A knee-length blush-pink fitted cocktail dress with short sleeves and a square neckline, a silver clutch, small silver earrings and nude block heels. Signature colour: pink.
Subject 7 (George): Refer to Image 14. 55, Natalie's weak-willed father, head of the Quinn family, remarried to Lauren. Outfit: look S1: A charcoal-grey two-piece suit over a white dress shirt, a silver-grey silk tie, a pale-grey pocket square and black leather oxfords. Signature colour: grey.
Subject 8 (Lauren): Refer to Image 15. 50, Natalie's controlling stepmother, George's wife and Cassie's mother, who holds the family purse. Outfit: look S1: A knee-length lilac-purple fitted sheath dress with short sleeves and a round neck, nude heels, a pearl necklace, pearl studs and the same slim gold wristwatch. Signature colour: purple.
Environment (Garden of the wedding venue): Refer to Images 2 to 6. Day, bright sunny garden light. High sunlight from the rose-bush side, warm soft highlights on the arch and the lawn. Live sound: birdsong, a light breeze in the drapes, guests murmuring.
Do not swap the characters' appearances, clothing, actions, positions or dialogue.
[Subjects and relationships]
Only eight people appear throughout: Cassie, Sebastian, Natalie, Officiant, Guest 2, Guest 1, George, and Lauren.
[Blocking]
Refer to Images 2 to 6 for the room and Image 7 for the people's places. Natalie and Sebastian stand close together, face to face, under the centre of the wedding arch, Natalie's hands lowering from his lapels, Sebastian on the boxwood-hedge side. George stands beside Natalie under the arch on the rose-bush side, holding the bouquet. The Officiant stands just behind the couple at the centre of the arch, facing down the aisle. Cassie stands at the head of the aisle a step in front of Natalie on the rose-bush side, holding the empty gift box. Lauren stands at the head of the aisle against the front-row chair on the boxwood-hedge side, her handbag on her arm. Natalie's phone lies face up on the seat of the front-row chair on the rose-bush side. Guest 1 (arch side) and Guest 2 (aisle side) stand at the one small round white high cocktail table on the boxwood-hedge side, each holding a champagne flute, Guest 1's phone in the clutch under her arm.
[Overall style]
Photorealistic live-action short drama with cinematic lighting. Each character keeps the face and the outfit with its main colour from their reference image throughout. Use each character sheet only for that character: the face from the close-up on the right, the body and outfit from the turnaround on the left; do not render the sheet's layout, white background or multiple views. This segment has 7 lines, in this order: Cassie, Sebastian, Natalie, Lauren, Sebastian, Cassie, Sebastian. Generate speech only from the lines in {} in the shot list, each spoken exactly once by its speaker; everyone else keeps their mouth naturally closed while listening, and a V.O. speaker keeps their mouth closed or is off screen. Follow the shot list below; do not add cuts or camera moves beyond it. Strictly adhere to the 180-degree rule: within a scene, characters keep their screen sides and the camera stays on one side of the axis. Seamless continuity of action, spatial matching and consistent actor blocking; cut on action. For dialogue prefer static shot-reverse-shot and over-the-shoulder shots, balanced with reaction shots and close-up inserts. Faces stable and clear, consistent with the reference images, with no resemblance to any real actor or actress. Normal human eyes. Natural anatomy and hands. Natural, fluid motion that follows the blocking; characters make subtle, natural movements. Characters, props and environment share one world with matched lighting. Each line ends naturally with breathing room and is never cut off. Authentic performances with micro-expressions. No BGM; generate only dialogue, environmental sounds and action sounds. No subtitles.
[Continuity]
Maintain continuity in the identities, number, appearance, clothing, relative heights, spatial positions, and eyelines of all the characters. The actions in the shot list occur strictly in sequence. Hands are anatomically correct.
[Strictly exclude]
added or missing characters, spatial jumps. malformed hands. subtitles or garbled text. Dialogue from the wrong character, multiple people speaking at once, repeated or missing lines, lip-sync errors and audio-visual desynchronization. The raw reference images (character sheets, setting plates) appearing as a frame of the video, and starting on a still frame of the setting reference. A fast zoom-in at the start, a fast pull-back at the end, unmotivated whip-pans, tilts, zooms and 360-degree orbits. Axis-crossing, jump cuts, frame skips, flicker and clipping. Face swaps, changes in age or clothing, sudden height shifts, added or missing characters, spatial jumps, and disordered action sequences; props popping in or vanishing, and duplicate characters except mirror reflections. Hand clipping, extra fingers, fused fingers, malformed hands. Subtitles, captions, watermarks and garbled writing; writing and logos other than those on a key prop's reference image, which are copied from it; a phone screen or paper that is not a key prop is shown from the back or out of focus. Black-and-white, monochrome, grayscale, desaturated visuals; hand-drawn, sketch, line art, illustration, comics, animation; storyboard frames, rough sketches, panel borders, gutters and grid layouts.
[Shot list] (11 shots, approximately 26 seconds)
When a previous-shot reference image is given, it is the moment this segment starts from: keep its people's positions, outfits, props and light, and continue from there. Shot 1 keeps its own camera, matching the image's framing only when it frames the same view; do not repeat that frame later.
Shot 1 (0-4s): [Medium shot, handheld camera following Cassie from in front of Natalie to Sebastian's side, eye-level, from the rose-bush side of the aisle] Cassie steps past the front of Natalie to Sebastian's hedge side under the arch and reaches for his arm with a seductive smile, the empty gift box in her other hand; Natalie and the Officiant stand behind them. Dialogue (Cassie, in English, sing-song and flirty): {Didn't know you could do that. Want to try with the prettier sister?}
Shot 2 (4-6s): [Medium shot, three-shot, locked-off camera, eye-level] Sebastian steps back out of Cassie's reach to Natalie's side and glances at Natalie; Cassie's hand closes on air and she backs off toward Lauren at the front-row chair on the hedge side. Dialogue (Sebastian, in English, unhurried): {I already did.}
Shot 3 (6-8s): [Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level] At the cocktail table by the hedge, Guest 2 laughs into her champagne glass while Guest 1 beside her, flute in hand, covers a grin. <A stifled laugh, a glass clinks>
Shot 4 (8-10s): [Close-up, clean single on her face, locked-off camera, eye-level] Cassie's smile drops; she flushes and glares toward the cocktail table, her fingers tightening on the gift box.
Shot 5 (10-12s): [Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, Sebastian's shoulder at one frame edge and George's arm at the other] Natalie, under the arch, turns toward Lauren at the front-row chair on the hedge side and holds out her palm; George beside her grips the bouquet. Dialogue (Natalie, in English, steely): {Wedding's over, Lauren. Where's the money?}
Shot 6 (12-14s): [Close-up insert, locked-off camera, eye-level] Lauren's hands clutch her small handbag tight against her hip, her diamond ring flashing.
Shot 7 (14-16s): [Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, from the rose-bush side of the aisle, Cassie's shoulder at the frame edge] Lauren, against the front-row chair on the hedge side with Cassie now beside her, lifts her chin with a thin, dismissive smile. Dialogue (Lauren, in English, clipped and cold): {We'll discuss that later.}
Shot 8 (16-18s): [Medium shot, slight low angle, slow push in on Sebastian, eye-line toward the head of the aisle] Sebastian steps up beside Natalie, still on her boxwood-hedge side, and fixes his eyes on Lauren. Dialogue (Sebastian, in English, calm and commanding): {Fifty thousand. You promised. Pay her.}
Shot 9 (18-21s): [Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, Lauren's shoulder at the frame edge] Cassie, beside Lauren at the front-row chair, folds her arms over the gift box and tilts her head with a sneer. Dialogue (Cassie, in English, mocking valley-girl lilt): {Already begging? You two really are perfect together.}
Shot 10 (21-24s): [Medium close-up, clean single, locked-off camera, eye-level] Sebastian smiles lazily, his steel-grey eyes moving from Cassie to Lauren. Dialogue (Sebastian, in English, smooth and amused): {Funny. You're the ones who can't afford to keep your word.}
Shot 11 (24-26s): [Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, from the rose-bush side of the aisle] Lauren's jaw tightens against the front-row chair, and Cassie beside her shoots a glare toward the arch.
At the end: Natalie and Sebastian stand side by side under the centre of the wedding arch, facing down the aisle, Sebastian on the boxwood-hedge side of Natalie. George stands beside Natalie under the arch on the rose-bush side, holding the bouquet. The Officiant stands just behind the couple at the centre of the arch. Lauren stands at the head of the aisle against the front-row chair on the boxwood-hedge side, gripping her handbag, and Cassie stands beside her on her arch side, arms folded over the empty gift box. Natalie's phone lies face up on the seat of the front-row chair on the rose-bush side. Guest 1 (arch side) and Guest 2 (aisle side) stand at the one small round white high cocktail table on the boxwood-hedge side, each holding a champagne flute, Guest 1's phone in the clutch under her arm.

<Image 18> is the previous shot (seg01/t02 at 28.96s).
